confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on aggregator estimates (CityCost and European cost-of-living sites) whose methods are not published. Beverage anchors are inferred from dated or undated Palm Springs happy-hour menus, adjusted upward toward regular menu prices. Cappuccino and beer are the most direct. Inexpensive meal, cocktail and wine are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July low-season resort market, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Hostel anchors are the least certain because the city has few hostels. FX is the RBA exchange-rates overview page value as at 15 October 2026; a 16 October figure seen only on a non-RBA mirror was not used, and the F11.1 table itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a North American resort and tourism city priced above the US average. Food and drink anchors are cross-checked against CityCost and European cost-of-living aggregator estimates for Palm Springs, plus happy-hour menus from several local bars. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for summer rates, with no search performed on accommodation prices.
